description: Compare the popularity of 2-5 topics (brands, competitors, products, people, keywords) by Wikipedia pageviews. Returns one jointly normalized 0-100 interest-over-time series per topic, share of attention, the most popular and the fastest-rising topic, and per-topic trend direction and spikes. A Google-Trends-style popularity comparison based on Wikipedia reading rather than searches. Suited to competitor analysis, brand tracking and content planning. Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402.
